the conjecture of McDiarmid et al. is true and the constant e-1/3 is the best possible.
a random graph drawn from a bridge-add-able class is connected asymptotically almost surely, with probability e-1/3 + o(1) and that this bound is sharp.
a random graph taken uniformly at random from a bridge-addability class is with high probability connected, and that this is best possible.

the study of connectivity properties of graphs taken uniformly from a class.
the study of the connectivity of a graph drawn at random from a given graph class.
the study of connectivity properties of random graphs in the framework of McDiarmid et al. conjecture.

the connectivity of random graphs from a bridge-addaddable class can be analysed in terms of a simple and intuitive property of the class.
